_comment: Shape of a weekly snapshot. Copy this, date it, fill what is real, leave the rest null.

format_split._comment: The number that decides what gets built. Average engagement rate per media type, with the post count it is averaged over — an average over 3 posts is not the same claim as one over 22.

authored_last_week.post_id: matches the id in the pack
authored_last_week.not_published_reason: the operator's own words, or null

prediction_scored.predicted: what last week's projection said, verbatim

experiment.testing: the one variable changed this week
experiment.result: unmeasured until next week scores it
